response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(archstat, 'Missing') AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM scanqc GROUP BY COALESCE(archstat, 'Missing')), totals AS (SELECT SUM(count) AS total_count, COUNT(*) AS num_statuses FROM status_counts), shares AS (SELECT status, count, CAST(count AS REAL) / (SELECT total_count FROM totals) AS share, 1.0 / (SELECT num_statuses FROM totals) AS avg_share FROM status_counts) SELECT status, count, share, share - avg_share AS above_average FROM shares WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC
